items.q: Who builds the still, and how do we check it?
items.a: [still builder: in-house or named maker]. Audit the shop, witness its hold points and read the sample turnover package; your quality unit approves the FAT protocol.

items.q: When do the FAT and IQ/OQ documents arrive?
items.a: The FAT protocol [protocol lead time, weeks] before the test. The executed report and the IQ/OQ protocols before the still ships, not during start-up.

items.q: Why distil when Ph. Eur. allows membrane WFI?
items.a: Distil for a hot loop, the longest inspection record, or cheap steam or power. Membrane saves energy where ambient storage suits. We model both when the choice is close.

items.q: Does an imported still need a CRN?
items.a: Yes. Pressure parts installed in Canada need a CRN under CSA B51 from the province, and may need design changes first. We register in [provinces where Aquemi registers].

items.q: Who services the still after handover?
items.a: Our team from [service locations], with spares in [stocking location]. A service plan states the severity 1 on-site response: [severity 1 on-site response time, hours].
